name: Amamoto Louis
source:
A genius who was dispatched in to overlook the direction the THP was taking, leader of the Anti-THP organization Black Outsiders. 

Despite her appearance, she is very mature and plays the role of a older-sister. She also insists that she is older than the protagonist.  

She insists on defeating the corrupt THP and bringing justice back to Tokyo. 

She is very intelligent and has supernatural abilities with machinery.
